cohort: 634 patients who presented for fistula repair at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, Islamabad, between 2006 and 2018.
finding: There was a rising trend in iatrogenic urogenital fistula, primarily attributed to hysterectomy, emphasizing the need for optimized surgical approaches and skilled gynecologic surgeons.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a contributor to iatrogenic fistula.
